title: crm.pipeline.deal.created
description: A deal was opened, by a person or by lead conversion. `owner_id` is the column deal's OWN scope compares with the caller's subject reference. `created_at` is the row's own creation time; an import may backdate it, so it can differ from the envelope's `occurred_at`. `closed_at` is non-null only for a deal created directly in a closed stage.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I3): services/deal/app/services.py:create_deal does not emit company_id, close_date, probability, closed_at, created_at yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
